scenario.feature: Read channel history and post summaries in customers' workspaces

summary.text: Slack supports OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow to grant bot and user tokens access to customer workspaces.
Reading public channel history requires requesting the channels:history scope, and posting channel summaries requires the chat:write scope.

Apps can be tested unlisted during early customer pilots, but apps intended for commercial distribution at scale must be submitted and approved for the Slack Marketplace, which takes up to 10 weeks for review.
Customer workspace administrators can enforce approval gates requiring admin permission before app installation.
Slack explicitly prohibits using customer data collected by apps to train LLMs, and listing on the Slack Marketplace incurs no fee.
Managed OAuth via Composio is available as an alternative setup path that can also suit production.

next_action.instruction: Configure the Slack app with required scopes (channels:history, chat:write) and security controls (TLS 1.2+, OAuth state parameter) to enable unlisted pilot testing while preparing submission materials for the Slack Marketplace review process.
next_action.success_condition: Slack app configured with correct scopes and security controls ready for unlisted testing and Marketplace submission.

paths.name: Slack Marketplace Distribution for External Commercial Customers
paths.applicability: Full commercial launch to external customers requiring listing in the Slack Marketplace.

gates.note: Slack Marketplace review requires meeting all developer policies and maintaining at least 10 active workspace installations throughout the review period.
Marketplace approval requires apps to use TLS 1.2+ and implement the OAuth state parameter to prevent forgery attacks.
Workspace admins can enforce approval gates requiring admin consent prior to installation.
Slack App Developer Policy explicitly prohibits using customer data collected by apps to train LLMs.
Slack does not charge fees for Marketplace inclusion.

prerequisites.text: Completed Slack app implementation with TLS 1.2+, state parameter enforcement, and compliant LLM data handling policies.
At least 10 active workspace installations maintained throughout review

limits.text: Marketplace review turnaround takes up to 10 weeks for new app submissions.

steps.title: Verify Security and Developer Policy Requirements
steps.instructions: Audit app implementation for TLS 1.2+ enforcement, OAuth state validation, and confirm customer data is not used for LLM training.
steps.success_condition: Security checks pass and data handling policies comply with Slack guidelines.

effort.explanation: Internal review of security settings and data usage documentation.

steps.title: Verify 10 Active Workspace Installs & Submit to Marketplace
steps.instructions: Verify that your app has at least 10 active workspace installations and maintains this threshold throughout the review period, as required by the official Slack notice. Then complete the Marketplace submission form in the Slack App Management Dashboard and submit for review.
steps.success_condition: App submission submitted successfully to Slack review team.

effort.explanation: Filling out listing metadata, installation instructions, and submission details.

steps.title: Complete Marketplace Review Process
steps.instructions: Respond to feedback from Slack reviewers during the review window (up to 10 weeks for new submissions).
steps.success_condition: App receives official Slack Marketplace approval and listing.

effort.explanation: External evaluation period conducted by Slack's review team.

conflicts.topic: Unlisted Pilot Distribution vs. Mandatory Marketplace Review
conflicts.description: While unlisted distribution is permitted for early customer pilots, Slack's updated policy mandates Marketplace submission for commercial distribution at scale and imposes rate limits on unlisted non-Marketplace apps.
conflicts.resolution: Use unlisted app distribution during pilot testing, then complete the official Slack Marketplace review prior to broad commercial release.
